name: Wisp
summary: A compact swerve robot with a spindexer, rotating turret, adjustable shooter, and tube-in-tube climber. Explore the systems that took Wisp to the NorCal District Championship.

name: Kelpie
summary: Built around a swerve drivetrain, elevator, arm, and end effector, Kelpie earned finalist finishes at the San Francisco and East Bay regionals.

name: Banshee
summary: A swerve-driven robot with an elevator, shooter, and climber. Banshee carried the team to the Milstein Division finals at the World Championship in Houston.

name: Paddo
summary: Our 2023 World Championship robot combines a swerve drivetrain, cascading elevator, roller grabber, and cube intake to handle cones and cubes.

name: Selkie
summary: A compact square swerve drivetrain, integrated router and shooter, over-bumper intake, and two-stage climber make up our 2022 robot.

name: Whirlpool
summary: Our second robot introduced swerve drive, a hood-style shooter, a cable-track climber, and a revolving mechanism that could carry five balls.

name: Nessie
summary: Meet the robot that started it all: a low-goal shooter, extending intake, and color-sensing control panel built by Team 8033’s founders.
